  • Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

  • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

What you'll bring:

  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

title: Client Advisor
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes

  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff

  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus

  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

Location

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Customer Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Produkt und der Umgebung unserer Kund:innen: ihrem Identity-Stack, ihren HR-Systemen, ihrem Security Review, ihrer KI-Roadmap. Du bringst einen Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite.

  • Integrationen, die Flip AI tragfähig machen: Du designst und lieferst Identity und Authentifizierung (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), SCIM-Provisioning, REST-APIs und Anbindungen an HR- und operative Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Beraten und befähigen statt selbst abarbeiten: Du führst die IT auf Kundenseite, ihre Partner und unsere externen Entwicklungspartner zu einer Lösung, die du selbst unterschreiben würdest, und sorgst dafür, dass sie ohne dich betrieben werden kann.

  • Bauen, wo es den Rollout löst: Wo Bauen der schnellste Weg ist, einen Ansatz zu belegen oder ein Rollout wieder in Bewegung zu bringen, baust du die erste Version und übergibst sie danach sauber, mit Dokumentation und Übergabegespräch, damit sie Bestand hat.

  • KI dort, wo sie auf den Kunden trifft: Du gestaltest, wie Agents, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und Agent-to-Agent-Szenarien in echten Enterprise-Umgebungen ankommen, inklusive der Auth- und Datengrenzen, die dabei halten müssen.

  • Technische Autorität im Account: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit Projektleitung, IT, Security, Fachbereichen und Betriebsräten ab, entscheidest die technischen Fragen und gibst die Lücken, die du dabei siehst, an unser Produkt- und Engineering-Team zurück. Rechne mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kund:innen, etwa 10 bis 30 Prozent deiner Zeit.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Rund 3 bis 5 Jahre (oder mehr) in der IT- oder Tech-Beratung, im Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering oder in der SaaS-Implementierung, mit echter Enterprise-Erfahrung.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integration und Identity: SSO und Authentifizierung (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID oder vergleichbar), REST-APIs und API-basierte Integrationen, die du in echten Enterprise-IT-Landschaften geliefert hast.

  • Technische Verantwortung am Kunden in Enterprise-Projekten, in denen du die technischen Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit IT, Security und Fachbereichen getroffen und nicht nur koordiniert hast.

  • Echte technische Tiefe, ohne in Vollzeit Produktcode zu schreiben: Du liest Code, prüfst ein Design, debuggst eine Integration und baust einen funktionierenden Prototypen.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher und fließendes Englisch.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit SCIM-Provisioning und Anbindungen an HR- oder Workforce-Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Ein fundierter, aktueller Blick darauf, wohin sich agentische KI entwickelt: MCP, A2A, EMA und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Feld eng verfolgt und eine eigene Meinung dazu hat, keine Jahre an Erfahrung, die es noch nicht geben kann.

  • Vorerfahrung als Customer Engineer oder Forward Deployed Engineer in einem Produktunternehmen statt ausschließlich in der klassischen Beratung.

  • Tools zur Workflow-Automatisierung (n8n oder ähnlich), Routine mit Logs, Metriken und Dashboards oder Erfahrung mit Mitbestimmung und Datenschutz im Enterprise-Umfeld.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an.

  • Erfolge feiern: Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du gestaltest Flip AI aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen.

  • Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip AI kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen.

Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wir im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. Das Wichtigste ist, dass DU zu uns passt!

title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Empower every employee.

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.

What you can expect

  • Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.

  • Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you.

  • Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.

  • AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.

  • Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.

  • Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.

  • Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.

  • German at C1 level or above and fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.

  • Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.

  • Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

title: Customer Success Manager - Landwirtschaft
description:
🌎 What we do

Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy.

📅 Over the next months, you will…

Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers

  • Own the success of a defined customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform

  • Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end, driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery

  • Design and run farmer-facing enablement, including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level

  • Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy

  • Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations.

🧺 What you bring along

  • Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives)

  • Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

  • First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end

  • People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind

  • Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency

  • Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus

  • Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week

🤗 You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning!

Root Global is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Solution Engineer - Vehicle OS
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Proficiency on airborne hardware and software qualification per ED-12/ED-80 (DO-178/DO-254), and practical experience with aircraft certification is a plus.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-energy, relentlessly optimistic Account Executive with proven experience in SaaS and the real estate/proptech sector. You are a confident “hustler” who sees the glass as half full and thrives in a high-activity sales environment.

This is a pure new business role where you will own a defined territory and named-account set in the DACH region. Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management, and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product, and senior executive support.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, and typically take six to nine months to close. Initial deal values range from £25k to £100k and have clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning requires a strong business case, quantified value discovery, and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT, and finance.

Core Capabilities & What You Will Own

Strategic Navigator & Deal Execution

  • Deeply understand account politics and decision-making structures to “connect the dots” within complex opportunities.

  • Ensure opportunities are qualified to a MEDDICC standard, featuring a quantified business case and direct access to the economic buyer.

  • Ensure every material deal is multi-threaded so that it survives any change of internal sponsor.

  • Lead commercial negotiations that build value and protect price, rather than defaulting to discounts.

  • Apply rigorous qualification to make early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process, or route to decision.

Relationship Builder & “Land and Expand”

  • Cultivate strong connections and effectively influence key stakeholders across your target audience.

  • Scope first wins so they can grow, ensuring sites, countries, and use cases are sequenced from the start.

  • Execute a clean handover to Customer Success with a fully documented expansion path.

Market Educator & Alliance Builder

  • Proactively educate market participants and win strategic partners to build valuable alliances.

Driven Execution, Pipeline & Coverage

  • Maintain a high volume of sales activity with resilience, confidence, and a proactive mindset.

  • Take personal responsibility for territory coverage, hitting a new business quota mapped out by a strategic territory plan.

  • Build pipeline through business development, marketing, partner channels, and self-generated activity.

  • Lead diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance, and risk.

Forecasting and Governance

  • Maintain a robust forecast with stage integrity, next steps, and close dates you confidently stand behind.

  • Surface risks early with an honest view of what has changed and what is needed.

  • Contribute to the sales playbook with competitive intelligence, repeatable use cases, and objection handling.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

  • Commercial Outcomes: Hitting new-logo ARR against quota, robust pipeline creation, territory coverage, and securing strategic logos. Strong win rates against incumbents or “no decision” outcomes, driving high average deal values and total multi-year value.

  • Operating Standards: High forecast accuracy, multi-threading, MEDDICC quality, price protection, discount discipline, CRM quality, and process discipline.

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: Complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage, and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: Achieve credible coverage against a ramped quota, progress multi-threaded opportunities through evaluation, and close (or materially advance) a first customer win.

  • By 12 months: Deliver against a ramped quota, establish a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and land accounts with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota (quality of results matters more than years).

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created, and representative deals won (we will ask for specifics).

  • The ability to walk us through significant deals end-to-end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • A structured seller who uses MEDDICC (or a comparable methodology) in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline required to run a predictable business.

  • English and German at a business level is a hard requirement.

  • Experience in CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech, or multi-site operations is a strong advantage.


Package, Support, and Progression

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Comprehensive support including business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing, and enablement to support your success.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching, and fast commercial decisions without a committee.

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training, and deal coaching, starting with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Clear progression into global accounts or sales leadership, as we back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals, and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers, and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

  • Oversee the development of working points and a density-tailored plasma source that survives the thermal load of a 100 Hz, 100 TW focus—millions of consistent shots, not one good shot

  • Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

  • Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

  • Own the vacuum system and the laser transport line, including vacuum chambers, differential pumping, vibration management and thermal management, turning the LPA into a machine that fits inside a shipping container and runs 24/7

  • Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

  • Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

  • Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

Requirements

  • Team leadership. You've built and led a technical team before. You're ready to be hands-on again before this one exists

  • Hands-on LPA experience. You've built and operated a laser-plasma accelerator. Not just modeled one. Injection, dephasing, depletion, and guiding physics you've tuned on real hardware

  • Experimental leadership at user facilities. You've planned and run a multi-year experimental campaign before. You know how to iterate a design from real beamtime data

  • High-power laser system literacy. You can write a spec a laser manufacturer can build to: pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality. You hold vendors to it

  • Vacuum and opto-mechanical engineering judgment. You know what vacuum chamber design, differential pumping, vibration isolation, and thermal management require to keep the LPA running under continuous, high-average-power use

  • Controls and diagnostics systems thinking. You can translate "runs unattended, 24/7" into concrete requirements for a control system, a machine protection system, and a diagnostics suite, even where another team builds them

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years postdoc experience

  • Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) required

  • At least full professional proficiency in English; German or Estonian is a plus

  • Willingness to work primarily on-site in Hamburg (no full remote; approximately one home-office day per week)

  • Occasional travel required to visit and work at different research facilities across the world

  • Ability to start in January 2027 or latest February 2027

Core Benefits

  • Key Role with Direct Impact: Without your LPA, our core product – the transportable muon source – cannot operate

  • Founding Role with High Autonomy: Build both the accelerator team and the machine from the ground up, taking full ownership of technical and budget decisions

  • Unique Deep-Tech Challenge: Hands-on work with laser-plasma accelerators at 100 Hz / 100 TW and active muon imaging technology that is revolutionizing industrial inspection

  • Access to World-Class Infrastructure: On-demand beamtime at multi-GeV facilities such as DESY PRIMA, plus collaborations with ELI Beamlines, EPAC, and ATLAS

  • Strong Network & Visibility: Collaborate with leading partners such as DESY, DLR, Siemens Energy, Marvel Fusion, and other high-tech organizations

  • Attractive Compensation Package plus a substantial employee equity program and relocation support, including for non-EU candidates

  • Culture of Ownership & Speed: A skunkworks approach, flat hierarchies, bold decision-making, and full transparency create an environment for personal growth

Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

  • Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
  • Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.

title: Senior Consultant | Manager (m/w/d) - Operational Transformation in Energy, Utilities & Resources
People & Culture - Working Student (all genders)
description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to drive turn everyday People administration into a seamless, high-quality experience for every single employee?

Are you ready to support both the operational engine and the talent growth of a fast-paced tech scale-up?

If you are a detail-oriented student who loves supporting people and keeping processes sharp by bringing employees and business needs together, then you are our perfect match!

Expect a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side. You will gain deep in-depth knowledge of the entire employee life cycle, from initial recruitment to the final stage of a successful career.

What You’ll Do

  • Support People Admin: You help our People Operations with everyday employee inquiries, such as holidays, workations and learning budgets, and you keep our Jira Service Management tickets moving with speed and care.

  • Help Keep Data Accurate: You support the maintenance of employee master data and digital personal files, following clear guidelines, so that everything stays accurate and up to date.

  • Document Support: You prepare employment certificates, reference letters and other essential HR documents in German and English.

  • Talent Spotlight: You help us look after the perfect candidate, from the first review of applications for junior roles to taking notes in interviews, so that the experience stays world-class.

  • Process Coordination: You help the recruiting process run smoothly by scheduling interviews and following up with stakeholders to keep the momentum high.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

  • You are currently enrolled and studying Business Administration, Human Resources Management, Psychology, or a related subject.

  • Initial experience in fast-paced companies or HR environment is a plus.

  • Experience in a Tech Scale-up environment is a bonus.

Skills

  • Bilingual Proficiency: You speak and write German and English at a professional level (C1/Native).

  • Organizational Talent: You can juggle multiple tasks and projects without losing your cool or your attention to detail.

  • Tech Savvy: You are comfortable (or eager to learn) working with tools like Personio, Leapsome, Jira, and Google Workspace.

Mindset

  • Detail Lover: Accuracy is your quiet superpower.

  • Discreet & Trustworthy: You handle sensitive data with care.

  • Eager Learner: You see feedback as fuel.

  • You enjoy both working as part of the People Team and collaborating with it: You come to our Berlin-Mitte office at least twice a week to work alongside us.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Recharge & Unwind: We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

  • Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

  • Exclusive Employee Discounts: Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.

  • Your Benefits, Your Choice: Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

What Matters to Us

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

  • Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du verantwortest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung deiner Mandanten in DATEV Lohn und Gehalt – unterstützt durch KI- und Automatisierungstools, die Routine minimieren und Tiefe ermöglichen.

  • Prozess- & Qualitätssicherung: Du gestaltest unsere Lohnprozesse aktiv mit – von der Mandanten-Schnittstelle über die Datenübernahme bis zur Lohnauswertung – und sorgst für gleichbleibend hohe Qualität.

Qualifikationen

  • Fachliche Basis: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Lohnbuchhalter/in, Fachassistent/in Lohn und Gehalt oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Sorgfalt & Termintreue: Der Lohn muss stimmen. Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und zuverlässig – auch unter Druck.

  • Unternehmerisches Mindset: Du willst direkt mitgestalten, wie KI-gestützte Lohnbuchhaltung aussieht – und mit Softwareentwicklern bauen, was es so noch nicht gibt.

  • Tech-Begeisterung: Du probierst neue Lösungen aktiv aus und siehst Technologie als Hebel – nicht als Bedrohung.

Benefits

  • 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht

title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)

  • Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit dem vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle – von Hypothese und Konzeption über komplexe Segmentierung, Kohorten und Flow-Aufbau bis zu Analyse und Iteration.
